title: Rafa No Raffa
style: Phonk + Latin trap with a driving 148 BPM bounce, rolling 808s, cowbell snaps, vinyl crackle, and urgent male rap delivery with Spanish ad-libs. Verse rides tense and bare; pre-chorus lifts with stacked chants and a filtered trumpet stab; chorus hits harder with gang shouts and a short bass drop. Bridge pulls to half-time then snaps back. Gritty, triumphant, street-level mix., latin, fake, loud, soul, low, clean, jazz, world, bounce, rap
lyrics:
[Intro]
Yeah…
Rafa no Raffa…
Rafa no Raffa…
Rafa the real one…

[Verse 1]
Came from the bottom, still got the flame
Rafa no Raffa, say it with the name
No fake stories, no mechanic game
Just bars and the hustle, remember the name
They tried to twist it, tried to rewrite the script
But Rafa stay solid, never took the L quick
From the block to the beat, from the struggle to the heat
Now he spitting on tracks, moving his feet

[Pre-Chorus]
Rafa no Raffa, say it how it is
Rafa no Raffa, real one in the biz
No cap, no lie, this the real vibe
Rafa on the rise, watch the whole world rise

[Chorus]
Rafa! Rafa! Rafa no Raffa!
Rafa! Rafa! Rafa no Raffa!
Say it with respect, say it with the facts
Rafa the rapper, never looking back
Rafa! Rafa! Rafa no Raffa!
Rafa! Rafa! Rafa no Raffa!
We know the name, we know the lane
Rafa on fire, bringing the flame

[Verse 2]
They tried to box him, tried to change the role
But Rafa stay Rafa, that’s how the story told
Mic in his hand, fire in his soul
Dropping real bars, that’s how he roll
From the late nights to the studio lights
Turning pain into power, turning wrongs into rights
Rafa no Raffa, keep the name clean
Rafa the rapper, living the dream

[Bridge]
336 in the back, signal ringing loud
Rafa in the front, standing on the crowd
No more confusion, no more doubt
Rafa the rapper — that’s what it’s about

[Final Chorus]
Rafa! Rafa! Rafa no Raffa!
Rafa! Rafa! Rafa no Raffa!
Say it with respect, say it with the facts
Rafa the rapper, never looking back
Rafa! Rafa! Rafa no Raffa!
Rafa! Rafa! Rafa no Raffa!
We know the name, we know the lane
Rafa on fire, bringing the flame
